brief: Photorealistic landscape industry navigation backgrounds. No people, faces, logos or readable text. Centered crop-safe subjects; lower quarter quiet. Blur applied in CSS only.

entries.scene: An independent colorful online shop fulfilment counter with neatly packed kraft parcels, folded blue and coral garments and a small unbranded product display. Warm amber daylight.
A bright contemporary clinic reception with teal chairs, a white curved reception desk, a stethoscope beside a closed appointment notebook and a small plant. Cool turquoise and soft green.
A sunlit university study room with open textbooks, a blue notebook and a globe on a wooden table, bookshelves in the background. Warm golden and blue accents.
An elegant contemporary home with terracotta accents, large windows, a welcoming living room opening to a green garden, property keys on the foreground console. Warm sunset light.
A boutique coastal hotel terrace with turquoise pool, woven lounge chairs and folded towels overlooking the sea. Rich aqua and warm coral accents.
A modern software product workspace with two unbranded monitors displaying abstract indigo workflow blocks, keyboard and cobalt task lamp, no readable UI text. Blue and violet accents.

A quiet financial adviser consultation desk with a calculator, neatly arranged document folders, a closed navy notebook and a pen, elegant green glass partitions behind it. Emerald and warm brass accents.
